terbaru.judul: Low-Dimensional Reduction Theory for Populations of Phase Oscillators with a Gaussian Frequency Distribution
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we develop an approximate low-dimensional reduction theory based on perturbation theory for weakly heterogeneous populations of phase oscillators with a Gaussian frequency distribution.

terbaru.judul: Asymmetric Coupling Anisotropy for Causal Information Filtering in Physical Reservoirs
terbaru.pelajaran: We demonstrate a physical mechanism for causal information filtering in a physical reservoir computing (PRC) by exploiting asymmetric coupling anisotropy.

terbaru.judul: Mixed-mode bursting oscillations in a three-timescale biophysical neuronal oscillator model
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we use a three-timescale biophysical cortical neuronal oscillator model to demonstrate that a three-timescale implementation of geometric singular perturbation theory (GSPT) provides stronger predictive insight into MMBO dynamics.

terbaru.judul: What sets the critical genome length for sympatric speciation? A closed form and asymptotic theory
terbaru.pelajaran: In the Derrida--Higgs model of sympatric speciation, a sexually reproducing population with finite binary genomes can mate only when the genetic overlap between two individuals exceeds a threshold $q_{\min}$.

terbaru.judul: Topology-Biased Resource Constraints Shape Synchronization Pathways in Hindmarsh-Rose Oscillator Networks
terbaru.pelajaran: We study a duplex system whose activity layer consists of chaotic Hindmarsh--Rose oscillators and whose transport layer redistributes a conserved resource through a degree-biased Markov process.

terbaru.judul: Inertial synchronization of networked oscillators in arbitrary dimensions
terbaru.pelajaran: Here, we introduce and analyze an inertial Kuramoto model in arbitrary dimensions.

terbaru.judul: Evolution of cooperation with Q-learning: how much information do we need?
terbaru.pelajaran: Cooperation is ubiquitous in both natural and human societies, yet its evolutionary basis remains a major challenge.

terbaru.judul: A nonlinear dynamics approach to assess amplitude-frequency coupling in non-invasive human electrogastrography recordings
terbaru.pelajaran: Conventional electrogastrography (EGG) analyses summarize gastric slow-wave activity using dominant frequency, power, or phase-based metrics, without explicitly modeling amplitude-dependent frequency dynamics.

terbaru.judul: Heterogeneity-enhanced stochastic resonance improves liquid-state computing in delayed spiking neural networks
terbaru.pelajaran: We investigate the joint effects of stochastic forcing and quenched structural heterogeneity on stochastic resonance (SR) and liquid-state computation in a small-world network of excitable FitzHugh--Nagumo neurons.
